purpose: does a like-for-like no-adaptation control exist for M2h?

stimulus.label: click train, IPI 35 ms
stimulus.carrier_rationale: geometric centre of the adapter passband 100-400 Hz (assumption, not literature)

statistic: difference of means vs 3.0 x SEM of the control mean

ignition.definition: excess over control >= 3 SEM AND stimulus active >= 90 %

absolute.note: the redefined ignition test compares stimulus with control and can miss a runaway that the control shares; these absolutes cannot
